profile.headline: Software Engineer, Frontend
profile.summary: My goal is to craft engaging and fresh web experiences with device agnostic approaches to delivering content, while continually sharpening my skills and connections in an increasingly connected world.

positions.title: Frontend Developer - Software Developer IV
positions.description:
Contributed to the development of a single page web application using React, TypeScript, and Vite with end to end testing in Playwright.

Championed and maintain shared design system and component packages.

positions.title: Frontend Developer - Software Developer III
positions.description:
Engaged in agile development of a ReactJS and TypeScript single-page application conforming to product development specifications. Utilized jest and service workers to enhance unit and integration tests using mocked network data and accelerate frontend development asynchronously to backend development.

Drove adoption of frontend best practices, standards, and technology as part of a frontend center of excellence.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Implemented website features and components per client specification using Gatsby and ReactJS, C# and Razor on top of Kentico Xperience CMS and Kontent headless CMS with primary focus on frontend web experiences.

Participated in a standards committee to drive frontend technology advancement and frontend development standards.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · English · Kentico · Kontent · GraphQL · Babel.js · GatsbyJS · C# · .NET Framework · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · ASP.NET · JavaScript · NodeJS · Webpack

positions.title: Frontend Developer - Software Developer II
positions.description:
Contributed to the full stack development and maintenance of a TypeScript AngularJS SaaS ERP application with external accounting and fulfillment integrations in TypeScript, ReactJS, .NET Core and facilitated team development by mentoring new developers on frontend web development.

Used Jest, NUnit and xUnit Integration Testing and Unit Testing to confirm software reliability and prevent regressions.

Lead and mentored a frontend modernization of a server rendered AngularJS OAuth authentication service to a ReactJS frontend, working alongside product and UI designers to implement security and user experience best practices from InVision mockups .

Engaged in a legacy modernization project, updating a server rendered Java application to an AngularJS solution powered by .NET Framework and ASP.NET SignalR. Implemented integration to Google Maps for real time tracking of service assets.

Participated in an exploration project using ReactJS Piral micro-frontends to provide customization and tailoring of web applications and deployment of custom modules and functionality to an existing SaaS application.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed enhancements and customizations for a web-based AngularJS B2B portal and desktop ERP application in .NET Framework following customer specifications and requirements.

Explored and integrated Commerce V3 eCommerce integration into SalesPad desktop ERP application.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
Contributed software enhancements for a web-based AngularJS B2B portal.

Collaborated with other interns in skills development and exploration into web scraping.

positions.title: Bookseller
positions.description: Assisted customers in purchasing product, provide in-store Nook technical support, and hand sold product. Cross trained in POS, Cafe, Customer Service, and Digital.

positions.description: Accepted donations, and assisted customers with product selection.

organizations.description: Handled event planning while acting as President for 3 months, handled communication between college faculty and organization officers, and coordinated meetings and task delegation. Managed organization multimedia assets, maintained the officer roster on school website. Operated as point of contact between organization and campus IT.
